window.forumShowCustomDialog = function(msg, isConfirm = false, hasInput = false, inputValue = '', placeholder = '', onConfirm = null) {
let overlay = document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'forum-custom-dialog-overlay';
overlay.className = 'selector-overlay absolute flex-center';
overlay.style.cssText = 'z-index: 9999; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: none;';
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div style="background: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); width: 300px; border-radius: 24px; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(130, 130, 130, 0.15), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(240,240,240,0.8);">
<div style="padding: 36px 24px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #555555; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(130,130,130,0.08); line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0.5px; word-break: break-all;" id="forum-custom-dialog-msg"></div>
<div id="forum-custom-dialog-input-container" style="display:none; padding: 0 24px 24px;">
<input type="text" id="forum-custom-dialog-input" style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #555555; outline: none; text-align: center; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(130,130,130,0.02);">
</div>
<div class="flex" style="height: 64px;">
<div class="flex-1 flex-col flex-center cursor-pointer" id="forum-custom-dialog-cancel" style="border-right: 1px solid rgba(130,130,130,0.08); color: #999999; display: none; transition: background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.02)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent'">
<span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; letter-spacing: 1px;">Cancel</span>
<span style="font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px;">取消</span>
</div>
<div class="flex-1 flex-col flex-center cursor-pointer" id="forum-custom-dialog-ok" style="color: #666666; transition: background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.02)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent'">
<span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; letter-spacing: 1px;">Confirm</span>
<span style="font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 500;">确定</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
`;
const forumContainer = document.getElementById('forum');
if (forumContainer) {
forumContainer.appendChild(overlay);
} else {
document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
}
document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-msg').innerHTML = msg;
const inputContainer = document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-input-container');
const inputEl = document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-input');
const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-cancel');
const okBtn = document.getElementById('forum-custom-dialog-ok');
if (hasInput) {
inputContainer.style.display = 'block';
inputEl.value = inputValue || '';
inputEl.placeholder = placeholder || '';
} else {
inputContainer.style.display = 'none';
}
if (isConfirm || hasInput) {
cancelBtn.style.display = 'flex';
} else {
cancelBtn.style.display = 'none';
}
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
cancelBtn.onclick = function() {
overlay.style.display = 'none';
if (hasInput && onConfirm) onConfirm(null);
else if (onConfirm) onConfirm(false);
};
okBtn.onclick = function() {
overlay.style.display = 'none';
if (onConfirm) {
if (hasInput) onConfirm(inputEl.value);
else onConfirm(true);
}
};
};

window.refreshCharForumProfile = async function(charId) {
const cacheKey = `forum_char_profile_${charId}_${currentWorldId}`;
await window.SimulatorAPI.db.set(cacheKey, null);
window.openCharForumProfile(charId);
};

window.openCharForumProfile = async function(charId) {
const char = availableContacts.find(c => c.id === charId);
if (!char) return;

let overlay = document.getElementById('forum-char-profile-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'forum-char-profile-overlay';
overlay.className = 'page flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'background: #fff; z-index: 2000; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow-y:auto;';
const forumContainer = document.getElementById('forum');
if (forumContainer) {
forumContainer.appendChild(overlay);
} else {
document.body.appendChild(overlay);
}
}
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="nav-bar flex-between" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; border-bottom: 1px solid #eaeaea; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: max(env(safe-area-inset-top), 20px);">
<div class="nav-left flex cursor-pointer" onclick="document.getElementById('forum-char-profile-overlay').style.display='none'" style="font-size: 20px; color: #262626; padding-left: 15px;"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i></div>
<div class="nav-title" style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: #262626; flex: 1; text-align: center;">${escapeHtml(char.name)}</div>
<div class="nav-right flex cursor-pointer" style="font-size: 20px; color: #262626; padding-right: 25px; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 15px;">
<i class="fas fa-sync-alt" onclick="window.refreshCharForumProfile('${char.id}')"></i>
<i class="far fa-envelope" onclick="window.openCharMessagesList('${char.id}')"></i>
</div>
</div>
<div id="char-profile-loading" style="padding: 50px; text-align: center; color: #888;">
<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin fa-2x"></i>
<p style="margin-top: 10px; font-size: 14px;">正在生成主页，请稍候...</p>
</div>
<div id="char-profile-content-area" style="display:none; flex-direction: column; padding-bottom: 20px;"></div>
`;
overlay.style.display = 'flex';

const cacheKey = `forum_char_profile_${char.id}_${currentWorldId}`;
let profileData = await window.SimulatorAPI.db.get(cacheKey);

if (!profileData) {
try {
const currentWorld = forumWorlds.find(w => w.id === currentWorldId) || defaultWorld;
const myP = getMyPersonaForChar(char.id);

const globalBooks = await getGlobalWorldBookContext();
const baseRule = getBaseRuleContext(currentWorld, globalBooks, true);
const memoryStr = await getMemoryString(char.id);
const wechatHistoryStr = await getRecentChatHistoryStr(char.id);

const prompt = `你正在为一个Instagram风格的社交APP生成角色【${char.name}】的个人主页。
${baseRule}
角色人设：${char.setting || '无'}
角色IP属地：${char.ip || '未知'}
【重要位置设定规则】：如果角色的人设中已经明确说明了ta当前生活在某个城市/国家或世界背景，请绝对以人设的所在地为准！IP地址仅作参考（可能是代理或注册地）。如果人设未说明所在地，再结合IP来生成符合该地风情的内容。绝对不要让人设与IP发生冲突导致OOC。
在ta眼里，用户的名字是【${myP.name}】，设定是【${myP.setting || '普通人'}】。${memoryStr}${wechatHistoryStr}
【内容与情绪要求】
1. 多数帖子可以和用户相关。请以角色自身的日常/工作/世界观切入，自然地表达对用户的关心、回忆或情绪。
2. 模仿真实人类在主页的发帖习惯，情感真实生活化，拒绝辞藻堆砌、无病呻吟或生硬做作的过度比喻。
3. 若为特殊/阴暗世界观，可展现对应尺度的情绪，但需保持活人感。严禁OOC。
要求输出纯JSON对象：
{
"bio": "个性签名（结合人设，一句话即可）",
"followers": "粉丝数（包含单位，如：1.2万）",
"following": "关注数（如：300）",
"bg": "主页背景图URL（推荐unsplash自然或城市风景图片横版，可用https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx）",
"posts": [
{
"content": "帖子正文",
"translation": "如果是外语帖子，这里写中文翻译。如果是中文帖子，这里留空字符串",
"location": "发帖时的IP所在城市或国家（例如：人在巴黎就写巴黎，必须与人设当前所在地一致，未知可留空）",
"imageDescs": ["第一张图的画面细节描述(例如人物特写)", "第二张图的画面细节描述(例如远景，绝对不能跟第一张重复)"]
}
]
}
生成5-10条帖子数据。
注意：posts数组里的每一项必须严格提供 1 到 2 个【完全不同】的 \`imageDescs\`（对应图片的文字描述）。严禁在JSON中输出自行生成的网络图片URL。如果有多张图，描述文案绝对不能雷同！
必须直接输出纯JSON对象，不要带任何markdown格式，也不要带\`\`\`json。`;
const res = await window.SimulatorAPI.ai.chat(prompt);
let jsonStr = res.trim();
const match = jsonStr.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
if (match) {
jsonStr = match[0];
} else {
jsonStr = jsonStr.replace(/^```json/, '').replace(/^```/, '').replace(/```$/, '').trim();
}
profileData = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
const placeholderImgs = [
'https://tc-new.z.wiki/autoupload/Lps16m1XQxemt1c-RRKmtdiO_OyvX7mIgxFBfDMDErs/20260331/wIOF/1290X1277/IMG_8683.jpeg',
'https://tc-new.z.wiki/autoupload/Lps16m1XQxemt1c-RRKmtdiO_OyvX7mIgxFBfDMDErs/20260331/uDWM/1290X1279/IMG_8681.jpeg',
'https://tc-new.z.wiki/autoupload/Lps16m1XQxemt1c-RRKmtdiO_OyvX7mIgxFBfDMDErs/20260331/NMVT/1290X1264/IMG_8682.jpeg',
'https://tc-new.z.wiki/autoupload/Lps16m1XQxemt1c-RRKmtdiO_OyvX7mIgxFBfDMDErs/20260331/uihn/1290X1274/IMG_8680.jpeg'
];
if (profileData.posts && Array.isArray(profileData.posts)) {
profileData.posts = profileData.posts.map(p => {
let descs = p.imageDescs || ["这是一张图片"];
if (!Array.isArray(descs)) descs = [descs];
const imgCount = descs.length > 0 ? descs.length : 1;
const images = [];
for(let i=0; i<imgCount; i++) {
images.push(placeholderImgs[Math.floor(Math.random() * placeholderImgs.length)]);
}
return {
...p,
images: images,
imageDescs: descs
};
});
}
await window.SimulatorAPI.db.set(cacheKey, profileData);
} catch(e) {
console.error("解析角色主页 JSON 失败", e, "原始返回:", res);
window.forumShowCustomDialog('生成失败: AI 返回的数据格式不正确');
document.getElementById('forum-char-profile-overlay').style.display = 'none';
return;
}
}

if (!profileData.bg || (!profileData.bg.startsWith('data:image') && profileData.bg !== '#1da1f2')) {
profileData.bg = '#1da1f2';
}

document.getElementById('char-profile-loading').style.display = 'none';
const contentArea = document.getElementById('char-profile-content-area');
contentArea.style.display = 'flex';

let avatarSrc = char.avatar;
if (!avatarSrc || (!avatarSrc.startsWith('http') && !avatarSrc.startsWith('data:'))) {
avatarSrc = window.getForumFallbackAvatar(char.name || '👤');
}

window._forumTempPosts = {};
const postsHtml = (profileData.posts || []).map((p, idx) => {
const fakePost = {
id: 'char_post_' + char.id + '_' + idx,
worldId: currentWorldId,
author: char.name,
avatarEmoji: avatarSrc,
time: '刚刚',
location: p.location || null,
content: p.content,
translation: p.translation || '',
images: p.images || [],
imageDescs: p.imageDescs || [],
likes: p.likes !== undefined ? p.likes : Math.floor(Math.random() * 100),
comments: p.comments || 0,
commentsList: p.commentsList || [],
timestamp: p.timestamp || (Date.now() - idx * 100000),
isLiked: p.isLiked || false,
music: false
};
p.likes = fakePost.likes;
p.comments = fakePost.comments;
p.timestamp = fakePost.timestamp;
p.location = fakePost.location;
window._forumTempPosts[fakePost.id] = fakePost;
return getPostHtml(fakePost, false);
}).join('');

const hasCustomBg = profileData.bg && profileData.bg !== '#1da1f2' && profileData.bg !== '';
contentArea.innerHTML = `
<div style="position:relative; width:100%; min-height:150px; height: calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-top)); padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top); background:#1da1f2; flex-shrink: 0;" onclick="document.getElementById('forum-char-profile-bg-input').click()">
${hasCustomBg ? `<img src="${profileData.bg}" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;" id="char-profile-bg-img-${char.id}">` : ''}
</div>
<input type="file" id="forum-char-profile-bg-input" style="display:none;" accept="image/*" onchange="handleForumCharProfileBgUpload(event, '${char.id}')">
<div style="padding: 15px; margin-top: -50px; position:relative; z-index:2; background: transparent; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; flex-shrink: 0;">
<div style="margin-bottom:10px;">
<img src="${avatarSrc}" style="width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;object-fit:cover;background:#ccc;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">
</div>

<div style="font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:#262626; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:center;">${escapeHtml(char.name)}</div>
<div style="font-size:14px; color:#262626; margin-bottom:15px; white-space:pre-wrap; text-align:center;">${escapeHtml(profileData.bio || '暂无签名')}</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:60px; padding-bottom:15px; border-bottom:1px solid #dbdbdb; width:100%; justify-content:center;">
<div style="text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:bold;display:block;">${profileData.posts ? profileData.posts.length : 0}</span><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8e8e8e;">帖子</span></div>
<div style="text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:bold;display:block;">${profileData.followers || 0}</span><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8e8e8e;">粉丝</span></div>
<div style="text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:bold;display:block;">${profileData.following || 0}</span><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8e8e8e;">关注</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding-bottom:20px; background:#fafafa;">
${postsHtml}
${(!profileData.posts || profileData.posts.length === 0) ? '<div style="width:100%; padding:40px; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:center; color:#888; font-size:14px;">还没有发布帖子</div>' : ''}
</div>
`;
};

if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initForumApp);
else initForumApp();

window.addEventListener('profileUpdated', initForumApp);
window.addEventListener('friendsUpdated', initForumApp);
})();

</script>
<script>
// Market App Logic
(function() {

walletData: { balance: 0 },

const SIM = window.SimulatorAPI;

// --- 弹窗与 UI 工具 ---
window.marketShowCustomDialog = function(msg, isConfirm = false, hasInput = false, inputValue = '', placeholder = '', onConfirm = null) {
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-custom-dialog-overlay';
overlay.className = 'selector-overlay absolute flex-center';
overlay.style.cssText = 'z-index: 9999; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: none;';
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div style="background: rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); width: 300px; border-radius: 24px; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(130, 130, 130, 0.15), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(240,240,240,0.8);">
<div style="padding: 36px 24px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #555555; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(130,130,130,0.08); line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0.5px; word-break: break-all;" id="market-custom-dialog-msg"></div>
<div id="market-custom-dialog-input-container" style="display:none; padding: 0 24px 24px;">
<input type="text" id="market-custom-dialog-input" style="width: 100%; padding: 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 15px; color: #555555; outline: none; text-align: center; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(130,130,130,0.02);">
</div>
<div class="flex" style="height: 64px;">
<div class="flex-1 flex-col flex-center cursor-pointer" id="market-custom-dialog-cancel" style="border-right: 1px solid rgba(130,130,130,0.08); color: #999999; display: none; transition: background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.02)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent'">
<span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; letter-spacing: 1px;">Cancel</span>
<span style="font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px;">取消</span>
</div>
<div class="flex-1 flex-col flex-center cursor-pointer" id="market-custom-dialog-ok" style="color: #666666; transition: background 0.2s;" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(0,0,0,0.02)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='transparent'">
<span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; letter-spacing: 1px;">Confirm</span>
<span style="font-size: 10px; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 500;">确定</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
`;
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}
document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-msg').innerHTML = msg;
const inputContainer = document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-input-container');
const inputEl = document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-input');
const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-cancel');
const okBtn = document.getElementById('market-custom-dialog-ok');
if (hasInput) {
inputContainer.style.display = 'block';
inputEl.value = inputValue || '';
inputEl.placeholder = placeholder || '';
} else {
inputContainer.style.display = 'none';
}
if (isConfirm || hasInput) {
cancelBtn.style.display = 'flex';
} else {
cancelBtn.style.display = 'none';
}
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
cancelBtn.onclick = function() {
overlay.style.display = 'none';
if (hasInput && onConfirm) onConfirm(null);
else if (onConfirm) onConfirm(false);
};
okBtn.onclick = function() {
overlay.style.display = 'none';
if (onConfirm) {
if (hasInput) onConfirm(inputEl.value);
else onConfirm(true);
}
};
};

async function loadData() {
if (SIM && SIM.db && !SIM.db.idb) {
try { await SIM.db.init(); } catch(e) { console.error('DB Init Error in Market:', e); }
}
if (!SIM || !SIM.db) return;

marketData.shopItems = await SIM.db.get('market_shop_items', generateDefaultShopItems());
// 强制更新旧的默认数据
if (marketData.shopItems.length > 0 && (marketData.shopItems[0].name === '高级护理套装' || marketData.shopItems.some(i => i.name === '精选咖啡'))) {
marketData.shopItems = generateDefaultShopItems();
await saveData('market_shop_items', marketData.shopItems);
}

marketData.secondhandItems = await SIM.db.get('market_secondhand_items', []);
// marketData.cartItems is removed, we use secondhandItems with isAuction flag
marketData.warehouseItems = await SIM.db.get('market_warehouse_items', []);

marketData.friends = await SIM.db.get('friends', []);
marketData.friends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isAltAccount && f.showInContacts !== false);
marketData.messages = await SIM.db.get('messages', {});
marketData.unreadCounts = await SIM.db.get('unread_counts', {});
marketData.myProfile = await SIM.db.get('my_profile', {name: '我'});
marketData.walletData = await SIM.db.get('wallet', { balance: 0, transactions: [] });
marketData.friendWarehouseData = await SIM.db.get('friend_warehouse_data', {});
marketData.excludedFriends = await SIM.db.get('market_excluded_friends', []);

// 修复之前可能产生的NaN价格和余额
let needSaveShop = false;
marketData.shopItems.forEach(item => {
if (isNaN(parseFloat(item.price))) {
item.price = (10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90)).toFixed(2);
needSaveShop = true;
}
});
if (needSaveShop) await saveData('market_shop_items', marketData.shopItems);

if (isNaN(marketData.walletData.balance) || marketData.walletData.balance === null) {
marketData.walletData.balance = 0;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
}
}

async function saveData(key, val) {
if (!SIM || !SIM.db) return;
await SIM.db.set(key, val);
}
async function sendWechatMsg(friendId, friendName, text, translation = '') {
let msgs = marketData.messages[friendId] || [];
msgs.push({
text: text,
translation: translation,
isMine: false,
senderName: friendName,
isEmoticon: false,
meaning: '',
type: 'text',
extra: null,
time: Date.now(),
isBlockedMsg: false
});
marketData.messages[friendId] = msgs;
await saveData('messages', marketData.messages);
let counts = marketData.unreadCounts || {};
counts[friendId] = (counts[friendId] || 0) + 1;
await saveData('unread_counts', counts);
if (window.renderChatList) window.renderChatList();
window.marketShowCustomDialog(`收到来自 ${friendName} 的微信新消息！`);
}

// 将方法暴露到全局
window.MarketApp = window.MarketApp || {};
window.MarketApp.marketShowCustomDialog = window.marketShowCustomDialog;

window.MarketApp.addGiftToWarehouse = async function(itemData, fromUserId, fromUserName) {
if (itemData.itemType === 'takeout') return; // 不包括外卖
if (!marketData.warehouseItems) marketData.warehouseItems = [];
marketData.warehouseItems.push({
id: 'wh_' + Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),
name: itemData.name,
fromUserId: fromUserId,
fromUserName: fromUserName,
icon: itemData.icon || 'fa-gift',
color: '#8c8c8c', // 灰色图标
imgUrl: '', // 进仓库不显示图片，显示灰色图标
desc: '好友赠送的礼物或代付商品'
});
if (SIM && SIM.db) {
await SIM.db.set('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);
}
renderWarehouse();
};

// ----- 新增：从微信快捷操作入口 -----
window.MarketApp.openItemSelector = function(type) {
window.MarketApp.currentAction = { type: type, friendId: window.currentChatFriendId };
if (window.switchPage) {
window.switchPage('market');
}
// 自动切换到商城标签

// --- 设置界面 (屏蔽好友) ---
window.openMarketSettings = function() {
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-settings-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-settings-overlay';
overlay.className = 'page flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'background: #f8f9fa; z-index: 4000; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow-y:auto; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;';
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}

const excluded = marketData.excludedFriends || [];
// 过滤群聊
const individualFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup);
let friendsHtml = individualFriends.length === 0 ? '<div style="padding: 20px; text-align: center; color: #999;">暂无好友</div>' : individualFriends.map(f => {
const isChecked = !excluded.includes(f.id);
return `
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:#fff; padding:15px; border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:10px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;">
<img src="${f.avatar || 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name='+f.name}" style="width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;">
<span style="font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#333;">${f.name}</span>
</div>
<label style="position:relative; display:inline-block; width:44px; height:24px;">
<input type="checkbox" onchange="this.nextElementSibling.style.background = this.checked ? '#495057' : '#ced4da'; this.nextElementSibling.firstElementChild.style.transform = this.checked ? 'translateX(20px)' : 'translateX(0)'; window.toggleMarketExcludeFriend('${f.id}', !this.checked)" ${isChecked ? 'checked' : ''} style="opacity:0; width:0; height:0;">
<span style="position:absolute; cursor:pointer; top:0; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; background:${isChecked ? '#495057' : '#ced4da'}; transition:.3s; border-radius:24px;">
<span style="position:absolute; content:''; height:18px; width:18px; left:3px; bottom:3px; background:white; transition:.3s; border-radius:50%; transform:${isChecked ? 'translateX(20px)' : 'translateX(0)'};"></span>
</span>
</label>
</div>
`;
}).join('');

overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="market-header" style="align-items:center;">
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('market-settings-overlay').style.display='none'"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i></div>
<div style="font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#212529;">市集设置</div>
<div style="width:32px;"></div>
</div>
<div style="padding: 20px;">
<div style="font-size:13px; color:#868e96; margin-bottom:15px; line-height:1.5;">加入闲置大厅的好友 (关闭后Ta将不再出现在你的闲置大厅中)</div>
${friendsHtml}
</div>
`;
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.toggleMarketExcludeFriend = async function(friendId, exclude) {
if (!marketData.excludedFriends) marketData.excludedFriends = [];
if (exclude) {
if (!marketData.excludedFriends.includes(friendId)) {
marketData.excludedFriends.push(friendId);
}
} else {
marketData.excludedFriends = marketData.excludedFriends.filter(id => id !== friendId);
}
await saveData('market_excluded_friends', marketData.excludedFriends);
// Remove their items from the secondhand list if excluded
if (exclude) {
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(item => item.sellerId !== friendId);
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
renderSecondhand();
}
};

async function fakeActiveItems(forceCount = 0) {
if (marketData.friends.length === 0) return;
const availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup && !(marketData.excludedFriends || []).includes(f.id));
if (availableFriends.length === 0) return;

const npcItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(item => item.isNPC);
if (forceCount > 0 || npcItems.length < 5) {
const normalItemNames = ["九成新机械键盘", "看过的书", "闲置耳机", "旧手机", "不用的台灯", "二手显示器", "复古相机", "闲置的滑板", "吃灰的健身环", "蓝牙音箱", "只穿过一次的球鞋", "演唱会门票", "闲置香水", "游戏手柄", "考研资料"];
const addCount = forceCount > 0 ? forceCount : 3;
for (let i = 0; i < addCount; i++) {
const randomFriend = availableFriends[Math.floor(Math.random() * availableFriends.length)];
let itemName = normalItemNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * normalItemNames.length)];
let price = (Math.random() * 100 + 10).toFixed(2);
marketData.secondhandItems.unshift({
id: 'sh_npc_' + Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),
name: itemName,
price: price,
sellerId: randomFriend.id,
sellerName: randomFriend.name,
isPrivate: false,
isNPC: true,
icon: 'fa-box',
color: '#8c8c8c',
desc: '闲置出清'
});
}
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
renderSecondhand();
}
}

window.refreshSecondhandItems = async function() {
const btnIcon = document.getElementById('refresh-sh-btn-icon');
if (btnIcon) btnIcon.classList.add('fa-spin');
try {
const availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup && !(marketData.excludedFriends || []).includes(f.id));
if (availableFriends.length > 0) {
let selectedFriends = [];
for(let i=0; i<8; i++) {
selectedFriends.push(availableFriends[Math.floor(Math.random() * availableFriends.length)]);
}
const memories = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('core_memories', {}) : {};
const prompt = `请生成8个二手闲置物品，分别属于以下8个人设的角色挂在二手市集上的物品。
每个物品必须符合对应角色的人设（如果有相关记忆也请结合记忆参考），名字简短真实，并给出合理二手价格（数字）。
角色列表：
${selectedFriends.map((f, i) => {
const mems = memories[f.id] || [];
const memStr = mems.length > 0 ? `。相关记忆：${mems.map(m=>m.content).join('；')}` : '';
return `${i+1}. 姓名：${f.name}，人设：${f.setting || '普通人'}${memStr}`
}).join('\n')}

请严格输出JSON数组，格式如下（不要任何其他字符）：
[
{"name": "物品1名称", "price": "价格", "desc": "简短的一句转手原因（符合人设，带点个人情绪，不要套路化）"},
...
]`;
const res = await SIM.ai.chat(prompt);
const jsonMatch = res.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error('No JSON array found in AI response');
const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length === 8) {
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(item => !item.isNPC);
for (let idx = parsed.length - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
const item = parsed[idx];
const friend = selectedFriends[idx];
let p = parseFloat(String(item.price).replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''));
if (isNaN(p)) p = 10 + Math.random() * 90;
marketData.secondhandItems.unshift({
id: 'sh_npc_' + Date.now() + '_' + idx + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000),
name: item.name,
price: p.toFixed(2),
sellerId: friend.id,
sellerName: friend.name,
isPrivate: false,
isNPC: true,
icon: 'fa-box',
color: '#8c8c8c',
desc: item.desc
});
}
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
renderSecondhand();
} else {
throw new Error('Invalid AI response');
}
}
} catch (e) {
console.error('Refresh AI failed, falling back to basic generation', e);
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(item => !item.isNPC);
await fakeActiveItems(8);
}
if (btnIcon) {
btnIcon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
}
};

window.removeSecondhandItem = async function(id) {
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(i => i.id !== id);
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
renderSecondhand();
};

window.removeMySecondhandItem = async function(id) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('确定要下架自己的这个闲置挂单吗？', true, false, '', '', async (res) => {
if (res) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (item) {
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(i => i.id !== id);
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
marketData.warehouseItems.push({
id: 'wh_' + Date.now(),
name: item.name,
fromUserId: item.originalFromId || 'me',
fromUserName: marketData.myProfile.name || '我',
icon: item.icon || 'fa-box',
color: item.color || '#8c8c8c',
desc: item.desc || '',
imgUrl: item.imgUrl || ''
});
await saveData('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);

renderSecondhand();
renderWarehouse();
window.marketShowCustomDialog('已下架，物品已退回仓库。');
}
}
});
};

window.buySecondhandItem = async function(id) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;

const executeBuy = async (paymentMethod) => {
let priceNum = parseFloat(item.price);
if (isNaN(priceNum)) priceNum = 0;

if (paymentMethod.type === 'balance') {
if (marketData.walletData.balance < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('余额不足！');
return;
}

marketData.walletData.balance -= priceNum;
if (!marketData.walletData.transactions) marketData.walletData.transactions = [];
marketData.walletData.transactions.unshift({
id: 'tx_' + Date.now(),
type: 'expense',
amount: -priceNum,
title: '购买闲置: ' + item.name,
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
if (window.renderWallet) window.renderWallet();
} else if (paymentMethod.type === 'family_card') {
const fc = marketData.walletData?.familyCards?.received?.find(c => c.id === paymentMethod.id);
if (fc) {
if (fc.limit < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('亲属卡额度不足！');
return;
}
fc.limit -= priceNum;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
}
window.triggerFamilyCardNotification(paymentMethod.friendId, item.name, priceNum);
}

marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(i => i.id !== item.id);
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);

marketData.warehouseItems.push({
id: 'wh_' + Date.now(),
name: item.name,
fromUserId: 'me', // 购买后即为我自己的物品，不再关联原卖家避免上架时触发质问
fromUserName: marketData.myProfile.name || '我',
originalSellerId: item.sellerId,
icon: item.icon || 'fa-box',
color: '#8c8c8c', // 强制灰色
desc: item.desc || '',
imgUrl: '' // 进仓库不显示图片
});
await saveData('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);

window.marketShowCustomDialog('购买成功！已放入我的仓库。');
renderSecondhand();
renderWarehouse();
if (item.sellerId !== 'me') {
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === item.sellerId);
if (friend) {
setTimeout(async () => {
try {
let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friend.id];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name || myName;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}

const prompt = `【系统内部触发：市集购买提醒】\n（这是一条系统自动触发的隐秘指令，用户并没有对你说话！）\n用户【${myName}】（人设：${myPersonaStr}）刚刚在二手市集上买下了你挂出的物品【${item.name}】。\n${item.isPrivate ? '这是一件你的私密/贴身物品，你感到很惊讶、害羞或者有点生气。' : '请根据你的人设自由发挥对这件事的反应。'}\n请你表现出是你自己发现了这件事，【自发、主动地】发消息给【${myName}】。\n结合你【${friend.name}】的人设，用符合你性格的口吻对【${myName}】说话。\n【极高优先级警告】：绝对不要在回复中提到“你刚刚告诉我”、“系统提示我”等暴露系统指令的话！你必须表现得像是你自己发现的！`;

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(prompt, true, null, false, '', 'system', { hidden: true }, friend.id);
setTimeout(() => {
if (window.generateAiReply) window.generateAiReply(friend.id, false);
}, 1000);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error('Market buy notify error:', e);
}
}, 2000 + Math.random() * 3000);
}
}
};

window.marketPay(item.price, `购买: ${item.name}`, executeBuy);
};

function renderShop(type = 'goods', searchTerm = '', forceIds = []) {
const container = document.querySelector('.shop-grid');
if (!container) return;
let items = marketData.shopItems.filter(item => item.type === type);
if (searchTerm) {
items = items.filter(item => item.name.includes(searchTerm) || forceIds.includes(item.id));
}

if (items.length === 0) {
container.innerHTML = `
<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#999;">
暂无相关${type==='goods'?'商品':'外卖'}
<div style="margin-top: 20px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;">
<button onclick="window.searchMarketShop()" style="padding: 8px 16px; background: #495057; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;"><i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> 重新搜索</button>
<button onclick="document.getElementById('market-shop-search').value=''; window.searchMarketShop()" style="padding: 8px 16px; background: #e9ecef; color: #495057; border: none; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;">显示全部</button>
</div>
</div>`;
return;
}

container.innerHTML = items.map(item => `
<div class="goods-item" onclick="window.clickShopItem('${item.id}')" style="cursor:pointer;">
<div class="goods-img-placeholder" style="background-image: url('${item.imgUrl}'); background-size: cover; background-position: center; border:none;"></div>
<div class="goods-info">
<div class="goods-name">${item.name}</div>
<div class="goods-price">¥ ${item.price}</div>
</div>
</div>
`).join('');
}

// --- 新增：点击商品展示操作菜单 ---
window.clickShopItem = function(id) {
const item = marketData.shopItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;

// 如果是通过微信聊天界面带目的进来的
if (window.MarketApp.currentAction && window.MarketApp.currentAction.type) {
const isGift = window.MarketApp.currentAction.type === 'gift';
const actionStr = isGift ? '赠送' : '请求代付';
window.marketShowCustomDialog(`确定${actionStr}【${item.name}】吗？`, true, false, '', '', (res) => {
if (res) {
const doSendMsg = () => {
if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
if (isGift) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(`[${item.type === 'takeout' ? '外卖' : '赠礼'}]`, true, null, false, '', 'market_buy', {
name: item.name,
price: item.price,
imgUrl: item.imgUrl,
status: 'pending',
itemType: item.type
});
} else {
window.pushGlobalMsg(`[请求代付]`, true, null, false, '', 'market_pay', {
name: item.name,
price: item.price,
imgUrl: item.imgUrl,
status: 'pending',
itemType: item.type
});
}
if (window.openChat && window.currentChatFriendId) {
window.openChat(window.currentChatFriendId);
} else if(window.switchPage) {
window.switchPage('wechat-chat-detail');
}
}
window.MarketApp.currentAction = null;
};

if (isGift) {
window.marketPay(item.price, `赠送: ${item.name}`, async (paymentMethod) => {
const priceNum = parseFloat(item.price);
if (paymentMethod.type === 'balance') {
if (marketData.walletData.balance < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('余额不足！');
return;
}
marketData.walletData.balance -= priceNum;
if (!marketData.walletData.transactions) marketData.walletData.transactions = [];
marketData.walletData.transactions.unshift({
id: 'tx_' + Date.now(),
type: 'expense',
amount: -priceNum,
title: `赠送: ${item.name}`,
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
if (window.renderWallet) window.renderWallet();
} else if (paymentMethod.type === 'family_card') {
const fc = marketData.walletData?.familyCards?.received?.find(c => c.id === paymentMethod.id);
if (fc) {
if (fc.limit < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('亲属卡额度不足！');
return;
}
fc.limit -= priceNum;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
}
if (window.triggerFamilyCardNotification) {
window.triggerFamilyCardNotification(paymentMethod.friendId, `赠送: ${item.name}`, priceNum);
}
}
doSendMsg();
});
} else {
doSendMsg();
}
}
});
return;
}

// 普通市集点击，弹出综合操作
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-item-action-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-item-action-overlay';
overlay.className = 'selector-overlay absolute flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'z-index: 3000; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display: none; justify-content: flex-end;';
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="selector-sheet absolute" style="background: #f5f5f5; padding: 20px; width: 100%; bottom: 0; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; box-sizing: border-box;">
<div id="market-item-action-title" class="text-center" style="margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 16px; color: #333; font-weight: 600;"></div>
<div class="selector-option flex" onclick="window.MarketApp.handleItemAction('buy')" style="border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; justify-content: center; color: #555555; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
<i class="fas fa-shopping-bag" style="margin-right: 10px;"></i> 直接购买
</div>
<div class="selector-option flex" onclick="window.MarketApp.handleItemAction('gift')" style="border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; justify-content: center; color: #555555; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
<i class="fas fa-gift" style="margin-right: 10px;"></i> 赠送好友
</div>
<div class="selector-option flex" onclick="window.MarketApp.handleItemAction('pay')" style="border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; justify-content: center; color: #555555; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
<i class="fas fa-wallet" style="margin-right: 10px;"></i> 请求代付
</div>
<button class="sheet-cancel" onclick="document.getElementById('market-item-action-overlay').style.display='none'" style="border-radius: 12px; background: #e0e0e0; color: #333; margin-top: 10px; padding: 16px; width: 100%; border: none; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer;">取消</button>
</div>
`;
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}
document.getElementById('market-item-action-title').textContent = item.name + ` (¥${item.price})`;
window.MarketApp.currentItemForAction = item;
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.MarketApp.handleItemAction = function(action) {
document.getElementById('market-item-action-overlay').style.display = 'none';
const item = window.MarketApp.currentItemForAction;
if (!item) return;

if (action === 'buy') {
window.buyShopItem(item.id);
} else if (action === 'gift' || action === 'pay') {
window.MarketApp.showFriendSelectorForAction(action, item);
}
};

window.MarketApp.showFriendSelectorForAction = function(action, item) {
if (!marketData.friends || marketData.friends.length === 0) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('你还没有添加任何好友。');
return;
}
const availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup);
if (availableFriends.length === 0) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('你还没有可用的单人好友。');
return;
}
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-friend-select-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-friend-select-overlay';
overlay.className = 'page flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'background: #f8f9fa; z-index: 4000; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow-y:auto; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;';
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}
const titleStr = action === 'gift' ? '选择好友赠送' : '选择好友代付';
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="market-header" style="align-items:center;">
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('market-friend-select-overlay').style.display='none'"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></div>
<div style="font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#212529;">${titleStr}</div>
<div style="width:32px;"></div>
</div>
<div style="padding: 20px;">
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: #666; margin-bottom: 15px;">物品：${item.name} (¥${item.price})</div>
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;">
${availableFriends.map(f => `
<div onclick="window.MarketApp.confirmSendActionToFriend('${action}', '${f.id}')" style="display: flex; align-items: center; background: #fff; padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
<img src="${f.avatar || 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name='+f.name}" style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 15px; object-fit: cover;">
<span style="font-size: 16px; color: #333; font-weight: 500;">${f.name}</span>
</div>
`).join('')}
</div>
</div>
`;
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.MarketApp.confirmSendActionToFriend = async function(action, friendId) {
document.getElementById('market-friend-select-overlay').style.display = 'none';
const item = window.MarketApp.currentItemForAction;
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId);
if (!item || !friend) return;
const actionStr = action === 'gift' ? '赠送' : '请求代付';
window.marketShowCustomDialog(`确定向 ${friend.name} ${actionStr}【${item.name}】吗？`, true, false, '', '', async (res) => {
if (res) {
const doSendActionMsg = async () => {
if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(
action === 'gift' ? `[${item.type === 'takeout' ? '外卖' : '赠礼'}]` : '[请求代付]',
true,
null,
false,
'',
action === 'gift' ? 'market_buy' : 'market_pay',
{
name: item.name,
price: item.price,
imgUrl: item.imgUrl,
status: 'pending',
itemType: item.type
},
friendId
);
} else {
let msgs = marketData.messages[friendId] || [];
const msgObj = {
text: action === 'gift' ? `[${item.type === 'takeout' ? '外卖' : '赠礼'}]` : '[请求代付]',
isMine: true,
senderName: marketData.myProfile.name || '我',
isEmoticon: false,
meaning: '',
type: action === 'gift' ? 'market_buy' : 'market_pay',
extra: {
name: item.name,
price: item.price,
imgUrl: item.imgUrl,
status: 'pending',
itemType: item.type
},
time: Date.now(),
isBlockedMsg: false
};
msgs.push(msgObj);
marketData.messages[friendId] = msgs;
if (SIM && SIM.db) {
await SIM.db.set('messages', marketData.messages);
}
}
if (window.openChat) {
window.openChat(friendId);
} else if (window.switchPage) {
window.switchPage('wechat-chat-detail');
}
};

if (action === 'gift') {
window.marketPay(item.price, `赠送: ${item.name}`, async (paymentMethod) => {
const priceNum = parseFloat(item.price);
if (paymentMethod.type === 'balance') {
if (marketData.walletData.balance < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('余额不足！');
return;
}
marketData.walletData.balance -= priceNum;
if (!marketData.walletData.transactions) marketData.walletData.transactions = [];
marketData.walletData.transactions.unshift({
id: 'tx_' + Date.now(),
type: 'expense',
amount: -priceNum,
title: '赠送: ' + item.name,
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
if (window.renderWallet) window.renderWallet();
} else if (paymentMethod.type === 'family_card') {
const fc = marketData.walletData?.familyCards?.received?.find(c => c.id === paymentMethod.id);
if (fc) {
if (fc.limit < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('亲属卡额度不足！');
return;
}
fc.limit -= priceNum;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
}
if (window.triggerFamilyCardNotification) {
window.triggerFamilyCardNotification(paymentMethod.friendId, `赠送: ${item.name}`, priceNum);
}
}
await doSendActionMsg();
});
} else {
await doSendActionMsg();
}
}
});
};

window.switchMarketShopTab = function(type) {
document.querySelectorAll('.market-shop-sub-tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
document.getElementById(`market-shop-tab-${type}`).classList.add('active');
document.getElementById('market-shop-search').value = '';
document.getElementById('market-shop-search').dataset.type = type;
renderShop(type);
};

window.searchMarketShop = async function() {
const input = document.getElementById('market-shop-search');
const term = input.value.trim();
const type = input.dataset.type || 'goods';
let recentlyGeneratedIds = [];
if (term) {
let localMatches = marketData.shopItems.filter(i => i.type === type && i.name.includes(term));
// 确保生成至少5个选择
if (localMatches.length < 5) {
try {
document.getElementById('market-shop-search-btn').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';
const prompt = `用户在市集商城搜索了【${term}】（类型：${type === 'goods' ? '商品' : '外卖'}）。
请你生成至少5个相关的好听的名字和对应的合理价格（具体数值）。另外再提供一个unsplash图片搜索词。
请严格输出JSON格式，不要任何其他字符：
{
"items": [
{"name": "名字1", "price": "价格1"},
{"name": "名字2", "price": "价格2"},
{"name": "名字3", "price": "价格3"},
{"name": "名字4", "price": "价格4"},
{"name": "名字5", "price": "价格5"}
],
"imageKeyword": "英文搜索词"
}`;
const res = await SIM.ai.chat(prompt);
const jsonMatch = res.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error('No JSON object found');
let parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
if (parsed.items && Array.isArray(parsed.items)) {
// 倒序遍历，确保 unshift 后顺序和生成的顺序一致
for (let i = parsed.items.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
let itemData = parsed.items[i];
if (!marketData.shopItems.find(existing => existing.name === itemData.name && existing.type === type)) {
let p = parseFloat(String(itemData.price).replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''));
if (isNaN(p)) p = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 90);
let newId = `${type}_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random()*1000)}`;
recentlyGeneratedIds.push(newId);
marketData.shopItems.unshift({
id: newId,
type: type,
name: itemData.name,
price: p.toFixed(2),
imgUrl: `https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/${encodeURIComponent((parsed.imageKeyword || itemData.name) + ' product high quality')}?width=500&height=500&nologo=true`
});
}
}
await saveData('market_shop_items', marketData.shopItems);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error(e);
} finally {
document.getElementById('market-shop-search-btn').innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-search"></i>';
}
}
}
renderShop(type, term, recentlyGeneratedIds);
};

function updateMarketHeader() {
const avatarEl = document.querySelector('.market-header-avatar');
const nameEl = document.querySelector('.market-header-name');
if (avatarEl) {
avatarEl.style.display = 'block';
if (marketData.myProfile.avatar) {
avatarEl.src = marketData.myProfile.avatar;
}
}
if (nameEl) {
nameEl.style.display = 'block';
if (marketData.myProfile.name) {
nameEl.textContent = marketData.myProfile.name;
}
}
}

function renderSecondhand() {
const container = document.querySelector('.secondhand-list');
if (!container) return;
if (marketData.secondhandItems.length === 0) {
container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; padding: 40px; color:#8e8e8e;">闲置大厅空空如也</div>`;
return;
}
container.innerHTML = marketData.secondhandItems.map(item => {
let imgHtml = `<i class="fas ${item.icon || 'fa-box'}"></i>`;
let auctionBadge = item.isAuction ? `<span style="background:#fa8c16; color:white; font-size:10px; padding:2px 4px; border-radius:4px; margin-left:4px;">拍卖中</span>` : '';
const displaySellerName = item.sellerId === 'me' ? (marketData.myProfile.name || '我') : (item.sellerName === 'user' ? (marketData.myProfile.name || '我') : item.sellerName);

let actionHtml = '';
let onTouchHtml = '';
if (item.sellerId !== 'me') {
actionHtml = `
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;">
<div onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.buySecondhandItem('${item.id}')" style="padding: 6px 14px; background: #495057; color: white; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;">购买</div>
<div onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.removeSecondhandItem('${item.id}')" style="padding: 6px 14px; background: #f1f3f5; color: #868e96; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;">不感兴趣</div>
</div>`;
} else {
actionHtml = `
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;">
<div style="font-size: 10px; color: #adb5bd; text-align:center; margin-bottom: 2px;">我的挂单</div>
<div onclick="event.stopPropagation(); window.removeMySecondhandItem('${item.id}')" style="padding: 6px 14px; background: #ff4d4f; color: white; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;">下架</div>
</div>`;
onTouchHtml = '';
}

return `
<div class="secondhand-item" ${onTouchHtml}>
<div class="sh-img-placeholder" style="color: #8c8c8c;">
${imgHtml}
</div>
<div class="sh-info">
<div class="sh-name">${item.name} ${item.isPrivate ? '<span style="color:#eb2f96; font-size:10px; border:1px solid #eb2f96; padding:0 2px; border-radius:3px;">私密</span>' : ''}${auctionBadge}</div>
<div class="sh-price">¥ ${item.currentBid || item.price}</div>
<div class="sh-user">卖家: ${displaySellerName} ${item.desc ? `<br><span style="color:#adb5bd; font-size:11px;">${item.desc}</span>` : ''}</div>
</div>
${actionHtml}
</div>
`;
}).join('');
}

window.openAuctionDetailReal(id);
};

};

window.triggerAuctionRound = async function(id) {
if (!window.currentAuctionRound) window.currentAuctionRound = 1;
const btn = document.getElementById('auction-continue-btn');
if (btn) {
btn.classList.add('loading');
btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> 思考中';
}
await window.simulateAuctionRound(id, window.currentAuctionRound);
window.currentAuctionRound++;
if (btn) {
btn.classList.remove('loading');
btn.innerHTML = '继续竞拍';
}
};

window.simulateAuctionRound = async function(id, round) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item || !window.currentAuctionItemId || window.currentAuctionItemId !== id) return;

// 获取参与拍卖的好友
const availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => window.currentAuctionSelectedFriends && window.currentAuctionSelectedFriends.includes(f.id));
if (availableFriends.length === 0) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('所有嘉宾已离场或无人参与。');
return;
}

const myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
if (!item.auctionChats) item.auctionChats = [];

// 随机本轮发言顺序
const friendsInRound = [...availableFriends].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

const lastBid = item.currentBid ? parseFloat(item.currentBid) : parseFloat(item.price);
const recentChats = item.auctionChats.slice(-15).map(c => `${c.senderName}: ${c.type === 'bid' ? '出价 ¥'+c.amount : c.text}`).join('\n');
const displaySellerName = item.sellerId === 'me' ? myName : (item.sellerName === 'user' ? myName : item.sellerName);

const memories = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('core_memories', {}) : {};

// 尝试获取全局的某个好友设置（随便取一个或者用全局默认，这里直接都加上判断）
const chatSettings = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_settings', {}) : {};
let prompt = `你现在的任务是模拟一场虚拟拍卖会的第${round}轮竞拍。
卖家是：【${displaySellerName}】（这是ta拿出来拍卖的私人或闲置物品）
拍卖物品：【${item.name}】
当前最高价：¥${lastBid}

最近的聊天记录：
${recentChats || '暂无'}

本轮参与者及对应的人设如下：
${friendsInRound.map(f => {
const mems = memories[f.id] || [];
const memStr = mems.length > 0 ? `。与【${displaySellerName}】的相关记忆：${mems.map(m=>m.content).join('；')}` : '';
// 获取该好友的翻译设置
const isTransDisabled = chatSettings[f.id] ? chatSettings[f.id].translationEnabled === false : false;
return `- 姓名：【${f.name}】，ID："${f.id}"，人设：${f.setting || '普通朋友'}${memStr} （翻译功能：${isTransDisabled ? '已关闭，强制纯中文输出' : '已开启，可输出外语并附翻译'}）`
}).join('\n')}

请你按照上述参与者的顺序，依次模拟他们每个人在本轮的竞拍表现。
每个人的表现要求：
1. 根据人设决定抬价幅度，抬价不要太猛（除非人设是特别有钱、财阀或霸总等富豪人设，才可以大幅加价）。
2. 太贵的物品如果超出了普通人的支付能力，该角色必须选择离场（不再出价）。
3. 如果还在出价，后一个人的出价必须大于前一个人的出价！
4. 配合出价（或离场），说1到3句话。可以表达为何出价、对【${displaySellerName}】的占有欲，或者嘲讽前面刚出价的对手；如果选择离场，则表达价格太高买不起或不值这个价的无奈/抱怨。
5. 如果话语中提到金额，必须与本次出价一致。
6. 展现出强烈的修罗场、针锋相对和阴阳怪气的气氛！

【多语言与方言格式规则】
对于设定中“翻译功能：已关闭，强制纯中文输出”的参与者，你必须全部使用纯中文，严禁使用任何外语或方言，translation 字段必须留空！
对于设定中“翻译功能：已开启，可输出外语并附翻译”的参与者，如果设定使用了外语或方言，必须在 translation 字段提供对应的【中文】翻译（绝对不能翻译成英文）；如果是纯中文，则 translation 字段留空。

请严格返回一个JSON数组，不要包含任何其他字符（不要有markdown的代码块标记）。数组每个元素对应一个参与者的表现，格式如下：
[
{
"friendId": "参与者的ID",
"characterName": "参与者名字",
"personaCheck": "我是谁？我的设定是什么？我对卖家的态度是什么？我为什么要做这个决定？(必填)",
"action": "bid 或 leave",
"bidAmount": "出价金额(数字，如果是leave则写0)",
"messages": [
{
"content": "第一句话原文",
"translation": "如果是外语/方言，填写【中文】翻译（绝对不能翻译成英文）；如果是中文则留空"
}
]
}
]`;

let resText = await SIM.ai.chat(prompt).catch(() => null);

if (resText) {
try {
const jsonMatch = resText.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error('No JSON array found');
const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
let currentHighestBid = lastBid;
for (let action of parsed) {
if (window.currentAuctionItemId !== id) break;

const friend = availableFriends.find(f => f.id === action.friendId);
if (!friend) continue;
let isLeaving = action.action === 'leave';
let friendBid = parseFloat(action.bidAmount);
let originalBid = friendBid;
if (!isLeaving) {
if (isNaN(friendBid) || friendBid <= currentHighestBid) {
friendBid = currentHighestBid + Math.floor(Math.random() * 41) + 10;
}
currentHighestBid = friendBid;
}
const newBidStr = isLeaving ? '0' : friendBid.toFixed(2);
let messagesList = action.messages || [];
if (!Array.isArray(messagesList)) {
messagesList = [{content: action.message || '...', translation: ''}];
}
if (messagesList.length === 0) messagesList = [{content: '...', translation: ''}];
// 同步消息中的价格
if (!isLeaving && originalBid !== friendBid && !isNaN(originalBid)) {
messagesList = messagesList.map(msgObj => {
let text = typeof msgObj === 'string' ? msgObj : msgObj.content;
let trans = typeof msgObj === 'string' ? '' : (msgObj.translation || '');
return {
content: text.replace(new RegExp(originalBid.toString(), 'g'), newBidStr),
translation: trans.replace(new RegExp(originalBid.toString(), 'g'), newBidStr)
};
});
}
// 一条一条出现
for (let msgObj of messagesList) {
if (window.currentAuctionItemId !== id) break;
let msgText = typeof msgObj === 'string' ? msgObj : msgObj.content;
let translation = typeof msgObj === 'string' ? '' : (msgObj.translation || '');
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'text',
senderId: friend.id,
senderName: friend.name,
text: msgText,
translation: translation,
time: Date.now()
});
window.renderAuctionChatList();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
}
if (window.currentAuctionItemId !== id) break;

if (isLeaving) {
if (item.auctionSelectedFriends) {
item.auctionSelectedFriends = item.auctionSelectedFriends.filter(fid => fid !== friend.id);
}
if (window.currentAuctionSelectedFriends) {
window.currentAuctionSelectedFriends = window.currentAuctionSelectedFriends.filter(fid => fid !== friend.id);
}
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'system',
text: `${friend.name} 觉得价格太高或不值得，退出了竞拍。`,
time: Date.now()
});
window.renderAuctionChatList();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));
} else {
if (!item.bids) item.bids = [];
item.bids.unshift({
bidderId: friend.id,
bidderName: friend.name,
amount: newBidStr,
time: Date.now()
});
item.currentBid = newBidStr;
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'bid',
senderId: friend.id,
senderName: friend.name,
amount: newBidStr,
time: Date.now()
});
const priceDisplay = document.getElementById('auction-current-price-display');
if (priceDisplay && item.currentBid) {
priceDisplay.textContent = `当前价: ¥${item.currentBid}`;
}

window.renderAuctionChatList();
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
}
}
}
} catch(e) {
console.error(e);
}
}

await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
};

window.renderAuctionChatList = function() {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === window.currentAuctionItemId);
const listContainer = document.getElementById('auction-chat-list');
const priceDisplay = document.getElementById('auction-current-price-display');
if (!item || !listContainer) return;
if (priceDisplay) {
const cp = item.currentBid || item.price;
priceDisplay.textContent = `当前价: ¥${cp}`;
}
if (!item.auctionChats || item.auctionChats.length === 0) {
listContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; color:#d4af37; font-size:13px; margin-top:20px; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">拍卖开始，大家快来围观！</div>';
return;
}

let html = '';
item.auctionChats.forEach(chat => {
const isMe = chat.senderId === 'me';
if (chat.type === 'bid') {
html += `
<div style="align-self:center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37, #fcc419); color:#fff; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:20px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; margin: 4px 0; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(212,175,55,0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);">
${chat.senderName} 出价了 ¥${chat.amount}
</div>
`;
} else if (chat.type === 'system') {
html += `
<div style="align-self:center; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color:#ccc; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:20px; font-size:11px; margin: 4px 0; font-style: italic;">
${chat.text}
</div>
`;
} else {
let textHtml = chat.text;
if (chat.translation) {
textHtml = `<div class="translatable-group" style="display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; max-width:100%; text-align:left; cursor:pointer;" title="点击切换翻译" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); const tc = this.querySelector('.trans-content'); if(tc) tc.style.display = tc.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';">
<span class="original-text">${chat.text}</span>
<span class="trans-content" style="display:block; margin-top:6px; padding-top:6px; border-top:1px dashed currentColor; font-size:0.95em; opacity:0.65; color:inherit;">${chat.translation}</span>
</div>`;
}
html += `
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:${isMe ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start'}; max-width:80%; align-self:${isMe ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start'}; margin-bottom: 2px;">
<div style="font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin-bottom:2px; padding:0 4px;">${chat.senderName}</div>
<div style="background:${isMe ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #d4af37, #b58d20)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'}; color:#fff; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:${isMe ? '12px 4px 12px 12px' : '4px 12px 12px 12px'}; font-size:13px; line-height:1.4; border:1px solid ${isMe ? 'transparent' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'}; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);">
${textHtml}
</div>
</div>
`;
}
});
listContainer.innerHTML = html;
listContainer.scrollTop = listContainer.scrollHeight;
};

window.sendAuctionChat = async function(id) {
const input = document.getElementById('auction-chat-input');
const text = input.value.trim();
if (!text) return;
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;
if (!item.auctionChats) item.auctionChats = [];
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'text',
senderId: 'me',
senderName: (marketData.myProfile.name || '我'),
text: text,
time: Date.now()
});
input.value = '';
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
window.renderAuctionChatList();
};

window.placeBid = async function(id, addAmount) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;
const lastBid = item.currentBid ? parseFloat(item.currentBid) : parseFloat(item.price);
const newBid = lastBid + addAmount;
if (marketData.walletData.balance < newBid) {
return window.marketShowCustomDialog('您的余额不足以支付此出价！');
}

window.marketShowCustomDialog(`确定出价 ¥${newBid.toFixed(2)} 吗？`, true, false, '', '', async (res) => {
if (res) {
if (!item.bids) item.bids = [];
item.bids.unshift({
bidderId: 'me',
bidderName: item.sellerId === 'me' ? '神秘买家' : (marketData.myProfile.name || '我'),
amount: newBid.toFixed(2),
time: Date.now()
});
item.currentBid = newBid.toFixed(2);
if (!item.auctionChats) item.auctionChats = [];
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'bid',
senderId: 'me',
senderName: item.sellerId === 'me' ? '神秘买家' : (marketData.myProfile.name || '我'),
amount: newBid.toFixed(2),
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
window.openAuctionDetailReal(id); // refresh
renderAuction();
}
});
};

window.customBid = function(id) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;
const lastBid = item.currentBid ? parseFloat(item.currentBid) : parseFloat(item.price);
window.marketShowCustomDialog(`请输入您的出价 (必须大于 ¥${lastBid})`, true, true, '', '输入金额', async (res) => {
if (res) {
const amt = parseFloat(res);
if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= lastBid) {
return window.marketShowCustomDialog('出价无效或低于当前最高价');
}
if (marketData.walletData.balance < amt) {
return window.marketShowCustomDialog('您的余额不足以支付此出价！');
}
if (!item.bids) item.bids = [];
item.bids.unshift({
bidderId: 'me',
bidderName: item.sellerId === 'me' ? '神秘买家' : (marketData.myProfile.name || '我'),
amount: amt.toFixed(2),
time: Date.now()
});
item.currentBid = amt.toFixed(2);
if (!item.auctionChats) item.auctionChats = [];
item.auctionChats.push({
type: 'bid',
senderId: 'me',
senderName: item.sellerId === 'me' ? '神秘买家' : (marketData.myProfile.name || '我'),
amount: amt.toFixed(2),
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
window.openAuctionDetailReal(id); // refresh
renderAuction();
}
});
};

window.finishAuction = async function(id) {
const item = marketData.secondhandItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;
if (item.sellerId !== 'me') return;

if (!item.bids || item.bids.length === 0) {
return window.marketShowCustomDialog('当前无人出价，无法成交！');
}

const winningBid = item.bids[0];
window.marketShowCustomDialog(`确定以 ¥${winningBid.amount} 成交给 ${winningBid.bidderName} 吗？`, true, false, '', '', async (res) => {
if (res) {
// Add money to wallet
const income = parseFloat(winningBid.amount);
marketData.walletData.balance += income;
if (!marketData.walletData.transactions) marketData.walletData.transactions = [];
marketData.walletData.transactions.unshift({
id: 'tx_' + Date.now(),
type: 'income',
amount: income,
title: '拍卖收入: ' + item.name,
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
// Remove from secondhand
marketData.secondhandItems = marketData.secondhandItems.filter(i => i.id !== id);
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
window.closeAuctionDetail();
window.marketShowCustomDialog('拍卖成交！资金已入账。');
renderAuction();
renderSecondhand();
if (window.renderWallet) window.renderWallet();
// Trigger WeChat msg from winner
if (winningBid.bidderId !== 'me') {
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === winningBid.bidderId);
if (friend) {
setTimeout(async () => {
try {
let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friend.id];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name || myName;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}

const prompt = `【系统内部触发：拍卖成交提醒】\n（这是一条系统自动触发的隐秘指令，用户并没有对你说话！）\n在虚拟拍卖会上，你成功拍下了用户【${myName}】（人设：${myPersonaStr}）的物品【${item.name}】，花费了¥${winningBid.amount}。\n请你表现出是你自己刚刚赢得了竞拍，【自发、主动地】发消息给【${myName}】。\n结合你【${friend.name}】的人设，用符合你性格的口吻对【${myName}】说话，表达你拍到物品的心情（可以抱怨太贵、傲娇、激动、嘲讽等）。\n【极高优先级警告】：绝对不要在回复中提到“你刚刚告诉我”、“系统提示我”等暴露系统指令的话！你必须表现得像是你自己刚经历完拍卖！`;

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(prompt, true, null, false, '', 'system', { hidden: true }, friend.id);
setTimeout(() => {
if (window.generateAiReply) window.generateAiReply(friend.id, false);
}, 1000);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error('Auction finish notify error:', e);
}
}, 2000 + Math.random() * 3000);
}
}
}
});
};

</div>

<div style="font-size:14px; color:#666; margin-bottom:8px;">我的零钱</div>
<div style="font-size:${balanceFontSize}; font-weight:700; color:#333; letter-spacing:-1px; word-break: break-all;">¥ ${balance}</div>
</div>
</div>
<div style="padding: 0 20px; background: #fff; min-height: calc(100% - 200px);">
<div style="font-size:15px; font-weight:600; color:#333; margin-bottom:5px; padding-top: 15px;">交易明细</div>
${txHtml}
</div>

overlay.style.display = 'flex';

function renderSettings() {
let hasPwd = !!marketData.walletData.payPassword;
let isPwdFree = !!marketData.walletData.passwordFree;
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="market-header" style="align-items:center; background: #fff; border-bottom: none;">
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('market-wallet-settings-overlay').style.display='none'"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i></div>
<div style="font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#333;">支付设置</div>
<div style="width:32px;"></div>
</div>
<div style="padding: 20px;">
<div style="background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); margin-bottom: 20px;">
<div style="padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;" onclick="window.setMarketPayPassword()">
<span style="font-size: 15px; color: #333;">${hasPwd ? '修改支付密码' : '设置支付密码'}</span>
<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #999;">

<span style="position:absolute; cursor:pointer; top:0; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; background:${isPwdFree ? '#07c160' : '#ced4da'}; transition:.3s; border-radius:24px; opacity: ${!hasPwd ? '0.5' : '1'};">
<span style="position:absolute; content:''; height:18px; width:18px; left:3px; bottom:3px; background:white; transition:.3s; border-radius:50%; transform:${isPwdFree ? 'translateX(20px)' : 'translateX(0)'};"></span>
</span>
</label>
</div>
</div>

<div style="background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">

<span style="font-size: 15px; color: #333;">赠送亲属卡</span>
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right" style="font-size: 12px; color: #999;"></i>
</div>
</div>
</div>
`;
}
renderSettings();

};

window.setMarketPayPassword = function() {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('请输入6位数字作为新的支付密码', true, true, '', '6位数字', async (res) => {
if (res) {
if (/^\d{6}$/.test(res)) {
marketData.walletData.payPassword = res;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
window.marketShowCustomDialog('支付密码设置成功！');
if (window.renderMarketWalletSettings) window.renderMarketWalletSettings();
} else {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('密码必须是6位数字！');
}
}
});
};

window.toggleMarketPwdFree = async function(checked) {
if (!marketData.walletData.payPassword) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('请先设置支付密码');
if (window.renderMarketWalletSettings) window.renderMarketWalletSettings();
return;
}
marketData.walletData.passwordFree = checked;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
if (window.renderMarketWalletSettings) window.renderMarketWalletSettings();
};

window.openGiveFamilyCardUI = function() {
let availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup);
if (availableFriends.length === 0) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('暂无好友可以赠送');
return;
}

let html = availableFriends.map(f => `<div style="padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.giveFamilyCardToFriend('${f.id}')">
<img src="${f.avatar || 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name='+f.name}" style="width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;">
<span style="font-size:16px; color:#333; font-weight:500;">${f.name}</span>
</div>`).join('');
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-family-card-selector');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-family-card-selector';
overlay.className = 'page flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'background: #fff; z-index: 4000; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow-y:auto; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;';
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}
overlay.innerHTML = `
<div class="market-header" style="align-items:center; background:#f8f9fa;">
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('market-family-card-selector').style.display='none'"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></div>
<div style="font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#333;">选择好友赠送</div>
<div style="width:32px;"></div>
</div>
<div style="flex:1; overflow-y:auto;">
${html}
</div>
`;
overlay.style.display = 'flex';
};

window.giveFamilyCardToFriend = function(friendId) {
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId);
if (!friend) return;
document.getElementById('market-family-card-selector').style.display = 'none';

window.marketPay('0.00', `向 ${friend.name} 赠送亲属卡`, async (method) => {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('亲属卡赠送成功！');
setTimeout(async () => {
try {
let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friend.id];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name || myName;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}

const prompt = `【系统内部触发：收到亲属卡提醒】\n（这是一条系统自动触发的隐秘指令，用户并没有对你说话！）\n用户【${myName}】（人设：${myPersonaStr}）刚刚给了你一张亲属卡（你可以用ta的钱买东西）。\n请你表现出是你自己发现了这件事，【自发、主动地】发消息给【${myName}】。\n结合你【${friend.name}】的人设，用符合你性格的口吻对【${myName}】说话，表达你的反应。\n【极高优先级警告】：绝对不要在回复中提到“你刚刚告诉我”、“系统提示我”等暴露系统指令的话！你必须表现得像是你自己发现的！`;

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(prompt, true, null, false, '', 'system', { hidden: true }, friend.id);
setTimeout(() => {
if (window.generateAiReply) window.generateAiReply(friend.id, false);
}, 1000);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error('Give family card notify error:', e);
}
}, 1500);
}, true, friendId);
};

// --- 使用全局的主程序支付验证替代原版自建面板 ---
window.marketPay = function(amount, title, onSuccess, isOpeningFamilyCard = false, friendIdForCard = null) {
if (window.requirePayment) {
window.requirePayment(amount, title, async (paymentMethod) => {
// 支付成功后重新读取一次全局钱包数据，确保操作前最新
if (SIM && SIM.db) {
marketData.walletData = await SIM.db.get('wallet', { balance: 0, transactions: [] });
}
if (onSuccess) onSuccess(paymentMethod || {type: 'balance', name: '零钱'});
});
} else {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('请在主系统运行以使用支付功能');
}
};

window.triggerFamilyCardNotification = async function(friendId, itemName, priceNum) {
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId);
if (!friend) return;
setTimeout(async () => {
try {
let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friend.id];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name || myName;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}

const prompt = `【系统内部触发：亲属卡扣款提醒】\n（这是一条系统自动触发的隐秘指令，用户并没有对你说话！）\n你给了用户【${myName}】（人设：${myPersonaStr}）一张亲属卡。就在刚刚，【${myName}】使用你的亲属卡消费了 ¥${priceNum}，购买了【${itemName}】。\n你收到了扣款通知。请你表现出是你自己收到了扣款通知，【自发、主动地】发消息给【${myName}】。\n结合你【${friend.name}】的人设，用符合你性格的口吻对【${myName}】说话，提及ta买了什么（可以是调侃、宠溺、抱怨或者其他情绪）。\n【极高优先级警告】：绝对不要在回复中提到“你刚刚告诉我”、“系统提示我”等暴露系统指令的话！你必须表现得像是你自己收到扣款通知的！`;

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(prompt, true, null, false, '', 'system', { hidden: true }, friend.id);
setTimeout(() => {
if (window.generateAiReply) window.generateAiReply(friend.id, false);
}, 1000);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error('Family card consume notify error:', e);
}
}, 2000);
};

window.confirmGiftWarehouseItem = function(itemId, friendId) {
document.getElementById('warehouse-gift-friend-select-overlay').style.display = 'none';
const item = marketData.warehouseItems.find(i => i.id === itemId);
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId);
if (!item || !friend) return;

window.marketShowCustomDialog(`确定将【${item.name}】赠送给 ${friend.name} 吗？`, true, false, '', '', async (res) => {
if (res) {
marketData.warehouseItems = marketData.warehouseItems.filter(i => i.id !== itemId);
await saveData('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(
`[赠礼]`,
true,
null,
false,
'',
'market_buy',
{
name: item.name,
price: '已购买',
imgUrl: item.imgUrl || '',
status: 'pending',
itemType: 'goods'
},
friendId
);
} else {
let msgs = marketData.messages[friendId] || [];
msgs.push({
text: '[赠礼]',
isMine: true,
senderName: marketData.myProfile.name || '我',
isEmoticon: false,
meaning: '',
type: 'market_buy',
extra: {
name: item.name,
price: '已购买',
imgUrl: item.imgUrl || '',
status: 'pending',
itemType: 'goods'
},
time: Date.now(),
isBlockedMsg: false
});
marketData.messages[friendId] = msgs;
if (SIM && SIM.db) {
await SIM.db.set('messages', marketData.messages);
}
}
window.marketShowCustomDialog('赠送成功！');
if (typeof renderWarehouse === 'function') {
renderWarehouse();
}

if (window.openChat) {
window.openChat(friendId);
} else if (window.switchPage) {
window.switchPage('wechat-chat-detail');
}
}
});
};

window.submitMarketSellItem = async function(id) {
const item = marketData.warehouseItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;

const priceInput = document.getElementById('market-sell-price').value;
const priceNum = parseFloat(priceInput);
if (isNaN(priceNum) || priceNum <= 0) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('请输入有效的售价');
return;
}

const descInput = document.getElementById('market-sell-desc').value.trim();
const isAuction = document.getElementById('market-sell-auction').checked;

marketData.warehouseItems = marketData.warehouseItems.filter(i => i.id !== item.id);
await saveData('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);
marketData.secondhandItems.unshift({
id: 'sh_user_' + Date.now(),
name: item.name,
price: priceNum.toFixed(2),
sellerId: 'me',
sellerName: marketData.myProfile.name || '我',
icon: item.icon || 'fa-box',
color: item.color || '#1890ff',
imgUrl: item.imgUrl || '',
desc: descInput,
isAuction: isAuction,
bids: [],
currentBid: null,
originalFromId: item.fromUserId
});
await saveData('market_secondhand_items', marketData.secondhandItems);
document.getElementById('market-sell-item-overlay').style.display = 'none';
window.marketShowCustomDialog('上架成功！');
renderWarehouse();
renderSecondhand();
renderAuction();
const availableFriends = marketData.friends.filter(f => !f.isGroup && !(marketData.excludedFriends || []).includes(f.id));
let friendsToNotify = [];
let foundSpecific = false;
if (item.fromUserId && item.fromUserId !== 'me' && item.fromUserId !== 'system') {
const specificFriend = availableFriends.find(f => String(f.id) === String(item.fromUserId));
if (specificFriend) {
friendsToNotify.push(specificFriend);
foundSpecific = true;
}
}
if (!foundSpecific && item.fromUserName && item.fromUserName !== '我' && item.fromUserName !== '系统商城' && item.fromUserName !== (marketData.myProfile.name || '我')) {
const specificFriend = availableFriends.find(f => f.name === item.fromUserName);
if (specificFriend) {
friendsToNotify.push(specificFriend);
foundSpecific = true;
}
}

if (!foundSpecific) {
const mentionedFriend = availableFriends.find(f => item.name.includes(f.name));
if (mentionedFriend) {
friendsToNotify.push(mentionedFriend);
foundSpecific = true;
}
}

// 移除随机发给其他人的逻辑。如果不是特定好友的物品，就不要有不相关的人来质问。

friendsToNotify.forEach(friend => {
// 100% 概率触发消息，如果是好友送的礼物，必定被质问
setTimeout(async () => {
try {
let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM && SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friend.id];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name || myName;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}

const memories = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('core_memories', {}) : {};
const mems = memories[friend.id] || [];
const memStr = mems.length > 0 ? `你与【${myName}】的相关记忆：${mems.map(m=>m.content).join('；')}\n` : '';

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(`[分享了闲置商品: ${item.name}, 金额: ¥${priceNum.toFixed(2)}]`, false, friend.name, false, '', 'market_share', {
name: item.name,
price: priceNum.toFixed(2),
avatar: marketData.myProfile.avatar || '',
author: myName,
imgUrl: item.imgUrl || '',
desc: descInput || ''
}, friend.id);
}

const prompt = `【系统内部触发：市集挂单提醒】\n（这是一条系统自动触发的隐秘指令，用户并没有对你说话！）\n用户【${myName}】（人设：${myPersonaStr}）把你送给ta的物品（或者原本属于你的私人物品或带有你名字的物品）【${item.name}】挂到了二手市集${isAuction?'拍卖':'卖掉'}了！\n挂单价格是：¥${priceNum.toFixed(2)}\n用户写的商品描述是：“${descInput || '无'}”\n你刚在市集上刷到了，并且已经把挂单截图（卡片）发给了ta，非常震惊/生气！\n请你表现出是你自己发现了这件事，【自发、主动地】发消息找【${myName}】算账。\n结合你【${friend.name}】的人设，用极其质问、震惊、生气、愤怒、不满或嘲讽的口吻对【${myName}】说话，可以吐槽ta定的价格或者写的描述。\n【极高优先级警告】：绝对不要在回复中提到“你刚刚告诉我”、“系统提示我”等暴露系统指令的话！你必须表现得像是你自己刷市集看到的！`;

if (window.pushGlobalMsg) {
window.pushGlobalMsg(prompt, true, null, false, '', 'system', { hidden: true }, friend.id);
setTimeout(() => {
if (window.generateAiReply) window.generateAiReply(friend.id, false);
}, 1000);
}
} catch(e) {
console.error('Market sell notify error:', e);
}
}, 2000 + Math.random() * 3000);
});
};

window.buyShopItem = async function(id) {
const item = marketData.shopItems.find(i => i.id === id);
if (!item) return;

const executeBuy = async (paymentMethod) => {
let priceNum = parseFloat(item.price);
if (isNaN(priceNum)) priceNum = 0;

if (paymentMethod.type === 'balance') {
if (marketData.walletData.balance < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('余额不足！');
return;
}

marketData.walletData.balance -= priceNum;
if (!marketData.walletData.transactions) marketData.walletData.transactions = [];
marketData.walletData.transactions.unshift({
id: 'tx_' + Date.now(),
type: 'expense',
amount: -priceNum,
title: '购买商品: ' + item.name,
time: Date.now()
});
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
if (window.renderWallet) window.renderWallet();
} else if (paymentMethod.type === 'family_card') {
const fc = marketData.walletData?.familyCards?.received?.find(c => c.id === paymentMethod.id);
if (fc) {
if (fc.limit < priceNum) {
window.marketShowCustomDialog('亲属卡额度不足！');
return;
}
fc.limit -= priceNum;
await saveData('wallet', marketData.walletData);
}
if (window.triggerFamilyCardNotification) {
window.triggerFamilyCardNotification(paymentMethod.friendId, `购买: ${item.name}`, priceNum);
}
}

marketData.warehouseItems.push({
id: 'wh_' + Date.now(),
name: item.name,
fromUserId: 'system',
fromUserName: '系统商城',
icon: item.icon || 'fa-gift',
color: '#8c8c8c', // 强制灰色
imgUrl: '' // 进仓库不显示图片
});
await saveData('market_warehouse_items', marketData.warehouseItems);

window.marketShowCustomDialog('购买成功！已放入我的仓库。');

updateMarketHeader();
renderWarehouse();
};

window.marketPay(item.price, `购买: ${item.name}`, executeBuy);
}
