window.showAssetDetail = function(type, itemsStr, friendId, passedCurrencySymbol) {
let items = [];
try { items = JSON.parse(itemsStr); } catch(e) {}
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId) || {name: "未知", id: friendId};
let currencySymbol = passedCurrencySymbol || '¥';
const typeMap = {
'fixed': { title: '固定资产', icon: 'fa-building' },
'current': { title: '流动资产', icon: 'fa-money-bill-wave' },
'intangible': { title: '无形资产', icon: 'fa-fingerprint' },
'longTerm': { title: '长期投资', icon: 'fa-chart-line' }
};
const t = typeMap[type];
let overlay = document.getElementById('market-asset-detail-overlay');
if (!overlay) {
overlay = document.createElement('div');
overlay.id = 'market-asset-detail-overlay';
overlay.className = 'page flex-col';
overlay.style.cssText = 'background: #000000; z-index: 4000; position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow-y:auto; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out; color: #ffffff;';
(document.querySelector('.phone-frame') || document.body).appendChild(overlay);
}
let totalValue = 0;
let itemsHtml = '';
if (!items || items.length === 0) {
itemsHtml = `
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 200px; color: #666;">
<i class="fas fa-folder-open" style="font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; opacity: 0.5;"></i>
<div style="font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 1px;">暂无资产记录</div>
</div>
`;
} else {
itemsHtml = items.map(item => {
let valNum = 0;
let valStr = "0.00";
let extracted = null;
let rawMatchStr = "";
let m1 = item.match(/(?:[¥₩円$£€฿]|估值|持仓|余额|价值|金额)\s*[:：]?\s*([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+(\.[0-9]+)?|[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(万|w|W|亿|元|美元|韩元|日元|镑|欧元|泰铢|卢布)?/);
if (m1) {
extracted = { numStr: m1[1], unit: m1[5] };
rawMatchStr = m1[0];
} else {
let m2 = item.match(/([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+(\.[0-9]+)?|[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(万|w|W|亿|元|美元|美金|块|韩元|日元|镑|欧元|泰铢|卢布)/);
if (m2) {
extracted = { numStr: m2[1], unit: m2[5] };
rawMatchStr = m2[0];
} else {
const all = [...item.matchAll(/([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+(\.[0-9]+)?|[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(万|w|W|亿)?/g)];
if (all.length > 0) {
let last = all[all.length - 1];
extracted = { numStr: last[1], unit: last[5] };
rawMatchStr = last[0];
}
}
}

if (extracted) {
let numStr = extracted.numStr.replace(/,/g, '');
valNum = parseFloat(numStr);
let multiplier = extracted.unit;
if (multiplier === '万' || multiplier === 'w' || multiplier === 'W') valNum *= 10000;
else if (multiplier === '亿') valNum *= 100000000;
if (!isNaN(valNum)) {
totalValue += valNum;
valStr = valNum.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
}
}

let mainName = item;
let extraDesc = "";
let parenMatch = item.match(/^(.*?)\((.*?)\)/);
if (parenMatch) {
mainName = parenMatch[1].trim();
extraDesc = parenMatch[2].replace(rawMatchStr, '').replace(/(估值|持仓|余额|价值|金额|[:：])/g, '').replace(/^[,，\s]+|[,，\s]+$/g, '').trim();
} else {
mainName = item.replace(rawMatchStr, '').replace(/(估值|持仓|余额|价值|金额|[:：])/g, '').trim();
}
if (valNum === 0) {
valNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 500000) + 10000;
valStr = valNum.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
totalValue += valNum;
}

let intPart = valStr.split('.')[0];
let decPart = valStr.split('.')[1] || '00';
// Adjust font size based on length
let moneyFontSize = intPart.length > 9 ? '20px' : (intPart.length > 6 ? '24px' : '28px');
let moneyHtml = `<div style="font-family: 'Optima', 'Didot', 'Bodoni MT', serif; font-weight: 300; color: #d4af37; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-top: 8px;"><span style="font-size: 16px; margin-right: 4px;">${currencySymbol}</span><span style="font-size: ${moneyFontSize};">${intPart}</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">.${decPart}</span></div>`;
return `
<div style="background: #111111; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px; border: 1px solid #333333; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
<div style="font-size: 14px; color: #d4af37; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;">
${mainName}
</div>
<div style="font-size: 18px; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; word-break: break-all;">
${extraDesc || mainName}
</div>
${moneyHtml}
<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #222222;">
<span style="font-size: 10px; color: #666666; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;">Asset Status: Excellent</span>
<span style="font-size: 10px; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px;">VERIFIED</span>
</div>
</div>
`;
}).join('');
}
let displayTotalHtml = '';
if (totalValue > 0) {
let tStr = totalValue.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
let intP = tStr.split('.')[0];
let decP = tStr.split('.')[1] || '00';
displayTotalHtml = `<span style="font-size: 20px; margin-right: 4px;">${currencySymbol}</span><span style="font-size: 38px;">${intP}</span><span style="font-size: 20px;">.${decP}</span>`;
} else {
displayTotalHtml = `<span style="font-size: 20px; margin-right: 4px;">${currencySymbol}</span><span style="font-size: 38px;">--</span>`;
}
let chartSvg = '';
if (type === 'fixed') {
chartSvg = `
<svg width="100%" height="100" viewBox="0 0 300 100" preserveAspectRatio="none">
<!-- Grid -->
<line x1="0" y1="20" x2="300" y2="20" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
<line x1="0" y1="50" x2="300" y2="50" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
<line x1="0" y1="80" x2="300" y2="80" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
<!-- Bars -->
<rect x="20" y="30" width="30" height="70" fill="url(#gradFixed1)" rx="4"/>
<rect x="70" y="50" width="30" height="50" fill="url(#gradFixed2)" rx="4"/>
<rect x="120" y="20" width="30" height="80" fill="url(#gradFixed1)" rx="4"/>
<rect x="170" y="60" width="30" height="40" fill="url(#gradFixed2)" rx="4"/>
<rect x="220" y="40" width="30" height="60" fill="url(#gradFixed1)" rx="4"/>
<rect x="270" y="70" width="30" height="30" fill="url(#gradFixed2)" rx="4"/>
<defs>
<linearGradient id="gradFixed1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
<stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.8" />

if (parsed.items && parsed.items.length > 0) {
itemsContainer.innerHTML = `<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 80px;">` + parsed.items.map((item, index) => {
const isPrivate = !!item.isPrivate;

const borderColor = isPrivate ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';

}).join('') + `</div>`;

if (parsed.assets) {

window.refreshFriendWarehouseData = async function(friendId) {
const friend = marketData.friends.find(f => f.id === friendId);
if (!friend) return;

const itemsContainer = document.getElementById('fw-items-container');
const assetsContainer = document.getElementById('fw-assets-container');
const loadingHtml = `
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height: 60%;">
<div style="width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #f0f0f0; border-top-color: #333; animation: spin 1s linear infinite; margin-bottom: 20px;"></div>
<div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #333; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 4px;">Loading Data</div>
<div style="font-size: 12px; color: #999;">正在获取数据...</div>
</div>
`;
itemsContainer.innerHTML = loadingHtml;
assetsContainer.innerHTML = loadingHtml;

let myName = marketData.myProfile.name || '我';
let myPersonaStr = '普通人';
try {
const chatPersonas = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('chat_personas', {}) : {};
const personas = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('personas', []) : [];
const pId = chatPersonas[friendId];
if (pId) {
const activePersona = personas.find(p => p.id === pId);
if (activePersona) {
myName = activePersona.name;
myPersonaStr = activePersona.setting || '普通人';
}
}
} catch(e) {}
let friendMemoryStr = '';
try {
const memories = (SIM.db && typeof SIM.db.get === 'function') ? await SIM.db.get('core_memories', {}) : {};
const friendMemory = memories[friendId] || [];
if (friendMemory.length > 0) {
friendMemoryStr = "相关记忆：" + friendMemory.map(m => m.content).join('；');
}
} catch(e) {}

let calculatedCurrencySymbol = '¥';
const settingStr = (friend.name + ' ' + (friend.setting || '')).toLowerCase();
if (settingStr.includes('韩国') || settingStr.includes('首尔') || settingStr.includes('财阀') || settingStr.includes('首尔')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '₩';
else if (settingStr.includes('日本') || settingStr.includes('东京') || settingStr.includes('大阪')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '円';
else if (settingStr.includes('美国') || settingStr.includes('纽约') || settingStr.includes('华盛顿')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '$';
else if (settingStr.includes('英国') || settingStr.includes('伦敦')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '£';
else if (settingStr.includes('欧洲') || settingStr.includes('法国') || settingStr.includes('德国')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '€';
else if (settingStr.includes('泰国')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '฿';
else if (settingStr.includes('俄罗斯')) calculatedCurrencySymbol = '₽';

const prompt = `用户"${myName}"（用户的人设：${myPersonaStr}）正在查看好友【${friend.name}】（好友人设：${friend.setting || '普通人'}）的个人资产和随身物品。
${friendMemoryStr ? friendMemoryStr + '。\\n' : ''}请结合两人的关系、人设和记忆，生成高度符合设定的资产与随身物品。
请严格输出JSON格式：
{
"currencySymbol": "${calculatedCurrencySymbol}",
"assets": {
"fixed": ["具体大标题1 (补充说明小标题，例如: 估值 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol}对应货币国家的合理数值)", "具体大标题2 (补充说明小标题)"],
"current": ["具体大标题1 (补充说明小标题，例如: 余额 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol}对应货币国家的合理数值)", "具体大标题2 (补充说明小标题)"],
"intangible": ["具体大标题1 (补充说明小标题，例如: 估值 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol}0)", "具体大标题2"],
"longTerm": ["具体大标题1 (补充说明小标题，例如: 持仓 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol}对应货币国家的合理数值)", "具体大标题2"]
},
"items": [
{"name": "物品1", "desc": "详细的物品描述...", "source": "专柜购入", "isPrivate": false},
{"name": "物品2", "desc": "...", "source": "旅行纪念", "isPrivate": false}
]
}
要求：
1. 资产必须分为固定资产(fixed)、流动资产(current)、无形资产(intangible)、长期投资(longTerm)四类，且必须符合其人设。**金额绝对要符合人设**：如果人设是穷人、普通人或学生，资产必须是符合其身份的低金额（例如没钱的学生，甚至可以没有固定资产），**绝对不要给普通人生成高额离谱的资产**！只有明确写了富豪、总裁等设定才能有高额资产。
2. 资产详情的大标题和小标题绝对不可以混淆！括号外面是“具体大标题”（例如：大通银行、旧金山公寓），括号里面是补充说明。大标题不能包含金额数字。
3. 货币符号的使用：我已经为你指定了该好友应该使用的 currencySymbol 为 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol}。**你必须在 assets 所有带有金额的补充说明括号内，严格且只使用 ${calculatedCurrencySymbol} 作为前缀！绝对禁止在数字前后加上“元”、“人民币”、“美元”、“块”等任何汉字单位或外语单位词！**
4. 【极其重要：当地物价与汇率常识】**数值面额必须符合该货币在其国家的真实购买力！** 例如，如果是美元($)，普通人的一辆二手车可能只要几千($5,000)，一套普通房子可能几十万($300,000)。如果是韩元(₩)或日元(円)，则面额数字会非常大（例如₩10,000,000）。**你绝对不能把人民币的数值原封不动地照搬给其他国家的货币（比如千万不要把价值人民币100万的房子写成 $1,000,000 这种极其离谱的错误）！**
5. 物品必须严格生成8个。其中6个是日常物品(isPrivate为false)，必须有2个是该好友的极度私密/贴身物品(isPrivate为true，例如贴身衣物、日记本、隐私小玩具、带有特别回忆的私人物品等)。物品来源(source)请使用自然真实的说法，私密物品的来源可以写“贴身保存”、“藏在床底”、“不为人知”等。绝对不要使用“人设自带”这种出戏的词，也绝对不要编造是用户(我)送的礼物。
6. 物品描述(desc)要详细一些，必须体现出好友的人设、以及TA和用户"${myName}"之间的关系/记忆。在描述中如果提及用户，请直接使用"${myName}"这个名字，禁止使用{{user}}、{user}或“用户”这种替代词。
7. 资产和物品内容必须严丝合缝地贴合给定的人设和记忆，不要出现脱离背景设定的物品。`;

try {
let parsed = null;
if (!localStorage.getItem('api_url') || !localStorage.getItem('api_key')) {
parsed = {
currencySymbol: "¥",
assets: {
fixed: [`市中心高档公寓一套 (约150平米, 估值 ¥12,000,000)`, `保时捷 Taycan (估值 ¥1,000,000)`],
current: [`招商银行金葵花卡余额 ¥2,500,000.00`, `支付宝余额 ¥150,000.00`],
intangible: [`个人自媒体账号 (粉丝300万, 估值 ¥5,000,000)`],
longTerm: [`纳斯达克100指数基金 (持仓 ¥1,500,000)`]
},
items: [
{name: "旧吉他", desc: "角落里放了很久的木吉他，琴弦有些生锈，但音色依然很好。", source: "旧物市场", isPrivate: false},
{name: "二手书籍", desc: "看了一半的科幻小说，书页有些泛黄，里面夹着一张旧书签。", source: "朋友赠送", isPrivate: false},
{name: "拍立得相机", desc: "一台复古的拍立得相机，外壳有些磨损，但还能正常使用。", source: "专柜购入", isPrivate: false},
{name: "手工皮夹", desc: "一个纯手工制作的真皮钱包，随着时间推移皮质变得更加柔软。", source: "旅行纪念", isPrivate: false},
{name: "银质项链", desc: "一条简单的银质项链，吊坠是一个小巧的星星形状。", source: "一直带在身边", isPrivate: false},
{name: "机械键盘", desc: "一把青轴机械键盘，敲击声音清脆，键帽有轻微打油。", source: "专柜购入", isPrivate: false},
{name: "私密日记本", desc: "带锁的厚重日记本，记录着许多不可告人的秘密和心情。", source: "贴身保存", isPrivate: true},
{name: "原味制服外套", desc: "平时不怎么穿的制服外套，上面还残留着若有若无的体香。", source: "藏在柜子深处", isPrivate: true}
]
};
} else {
const res = await SIM.ai.chat(prompt);
parsed = JSON.parse(res.trim().replace(/^```json|```$/g, ''));
}
if (!marketData.friendWarehouseData) marketData.friendWarehouseData = {};
marketData.friendWarehouseData[friendId] = parsed;
await saveData('friend_warehouse_data', marketData.friendWarehouseData);
window.renderFriendWarehouseContent(friendId, parsed);

} catch (e) {
const errorHtml = `
<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 60%; color: #ff3b30;">
<i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle" style="font-size: 48px; opacity: 0.5; margin-bottom: 16px;"></i>
<div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px;">Generation Failed</div>
<div style="font-size: 12px; margin-top: 8px; opacity: 0.8;">生成失败，请重试</div>
</div>
`;
itemsContainer.innerHTML = errorHtml;
assetsContainer.innerHTML = errorHtml;
}
};

async function initMarketApp() {
console.log('--- Market App Initializing ---');
await loadData();
await fakeActiveItems();

const marketContainer = document.getElementById('market');
if (marketContainer) {
marketContainer.innerHTML = `
<div class="market-header">
<div class="market-header-user">
<img src="${marketData.myProfile.avatar || 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=我&background=ccc&color=fff&size=120'}" class="market-header-avatar" style="display:block;">
<div class="market-header-info">
<div class="market-header-name" style="display:block;">${marketData.myProfile.name || '我'}</div>
<div class="market-header-balance">余额: ¥${marketData.walletData && marketData.walletData.balance !== undefined ? marketData.walletData.balance.toFixed(2) : '0.00'}</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="market-header-actions">
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="if(window.MarketApp.currentAction) { window.MarketApp.currentAction = null; window.switchPage('wechat-chat-detail'); } else { window.switchPage('home-screen'); }"><i class="fas fa-sign-out-alt" style="font-size:16px;"></i></div>
<div class="market-header-btn" onclick="window.openMarketSettings()"><i class="fas fa-cog" style="font-size:16px;"></i></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="market-body">
<!-- 商城视图 -->
<div id="market-tab-shop" class="market-view active">
<div style="padding: 15px 20px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f3f5;">
<div style="display:flex; background:#f8f9fa; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;">
<div id="market-shop-tab-goods" class="market-shop-sub-tab active" style="flex:1; text-align:center; padding:10px; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="switchMarketShopTab('goods')">商品</div>
<div id="market-shop-tab-takeout" class="market-shop-sub-tab" style="flex:1; text-align:center; padding:10px; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="switchMarketShopTab('takeout')">外卖</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex; margin-top: 15px; gap: 10px;">
<input type="text" id="market-shop-search" data-type="goods" placeholder="搜索更多..." style="flex:1; background:#f8f9fa; border:1px solid #e9ecef; padding:10px 15px; border-radius:20px; font-size:14px; outline:none;" onkeypress="if(event.key==='Enter') window.searchMarketShop()" oninput="if(this.value.trim()==='') window.searchMarketShop()">
<div id="market-shop-search-btn" style="background:#495057; color:#fff; width:40px; border-radius:20px; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; cursor:pointer;" onclick="window.searchMarketShop()"><i class="fas fa-search"></i></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="shop-grid" style="padding-top: 15px;"></div>
</div>

<!-- 闲置视图 -->
<div id="market-tab-secondhand" class="market-view">
<div style="padding: 10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.02); color:#495057; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 15px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
<span>闲置大厅物品</span>
<div onclick="window.refreshSecondhandItems()" style="cursor:pointer; background:#e9ecef; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:12px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-weight: 500;">
<i id="refresh-sh-btn-icon" class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> 刷新
</div>
</div>
<div class="secondhand-list"></div>
</div>

<!-- 拍卖场视图 -->
<div id="market-tab-auction" class="market-view">
<!-- 动态渲染 -->
</div>

<!-- 我的仓库视图 -->
<div id="market-tab-warehouse" class="market-view">
<!-- 动态渲染 -->
</div>
</div>

<div class="market-tab-bar">
<div class="market-tab-item active" data-tab="shop">
<i class="fas fa-store"></i><span style="font-size: 11px;">市集商城</span>
</div>
<div class="market-tab-item" data-tab="secondhand">
<i class="fas fa-recycle"></i><span style="font-size: 11px;">闲置大厅</span>
</div>
<div class="market-tab-item" data-tab="auction">
<i class="fas fa-gavel"></i><span style="font-size: 11px;">拍卖场</span>
</div>
<div class="market-tab-item" data-tab="warehouse">
<i class="fas fa-boxes"></i><span style="font-size: 11px;">我的仓库</span>
</div>
</div>
`;

renderShop();
renderSecondhand();
renderAuction();
renderWarehouse();

const tabItems = marketContainer.querySelectorAll('.market-tab-item');
tabItems.forEach(tab => {
tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
tabItems.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
marketContainer.querySelectorAll('.market-view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));

tab.classList.add('active');
const tabId = tab.getAttribute('data-tab');
const view = marketContainer.querySelector(`#market-tab-${tabId}`);
if (view) {
view.classList.add('active');
}
updateMarketHeader();
});
});

}
console.log('--- Market App Initialized ---');
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initMarketApp);
} else {
initMarketApp();
}

window.addEventListener('profileUpdated', initMarketApp);
window.addEventListener('friendsUpdated', initMarketApp);
})();

</script>
<script src="js/apps/schedule.js"></script>
<script src="js/apps/romance.js"></script>
<script src="js/apps/wechatGame.js"></script>
<script src="js/apps/reader.js"></script>
<script src="js/apps/meet.js"></script>
<script src="js/main.js"></script>
<script src="js/splash.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script>
<script>
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').then(registration => {
console.log('ServiceWorker registration successful with scope: ', registration.scope);
}).catch(err => {
console.log('ServiceWorker registration failed: ', err);
});
});
}

</script>
</body>
